_comment: Language-neutral parity contract for project name -> proj/<slug> derivation. The Rust CLI (crates/kiem-cli/src/project.rs to_tag/slugify) and the Swift app (apple/Kiem/Models/KiemModel.swift projectTag(for:)) must produce byte-identical `tag` for each `input`. Rule: lowercase ASCII A-Z only; keep [a-z0-9/]; space/-/_ become a single _; collapse repeats; trim leading/trailing _; non-ASCII is dropped; an empty slug yields an empty tag. See docs/specs/kiem-project-marker.md and docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/cross-language-parity-shared-fixtures-2026-05-30.md.
